subject.title: fix(cron): prevent scheduler death when startup catch-up fails

question: Should maintainers adopt this branch’s broader startup recovery and zombie-marker approach, or narrow/replace it using the current startup catch-up work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94022?
rationale: The remaining choice is not a mechanical rebase: it determines the canonical cron recovery policy for failed catch-up, deferred jobs, and one-shot replay behavior.

options.title: Rework on current main
options.body: Rebase or replace this patch, resolve all three prior P1 scheduler invariants, and add live recovery proof before reconsidering merge.

options.title: Adopt the narrower successor
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94022 covers the required startup-state invariant, keep this PR only for any independently demonstrated timer-recovery gap.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave the stale conflicting branch unmerged until a maintainer confirms a single canonical cron recovery design.
